mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (stimulant) and chlorpromazine (antipsychotic) have opposing pharmacodynamic effects; chlorpromazine may antagonize stimulant effects while lisdexamfetamine may worsen psychotic symptoms and increase cardiovascular stress.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use with caution and monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy, increased psychotic symptoms, and elevated cardiac effects including arrhythmias and hypertension.
